_comment: Copy this file to qa/local-paths.json (git-ignored) and put the absolute paths of YOUR OWN sample data in it. Nothing naming a real survey, site or job may ever be committed. Every key is optional; an env var (SEISCONV_QA_SEGY / SEISCONV_QA_LE / SEISCONV_QA_SPS, ';'-separated for a list) overrides it, and SEISCONV_QA_DATA_ROOT sets the folder the placeholder defaults resolve under.
